checks.title: Async correctness
items: Floating promises: an async call whose rejection nobody observes (missing `await`, `void`, `.catch`).
Missing cancellation/timeouts on network calls; unhandled `AbortSignal`.

checks.title: Value and type traps
items: `==`/`!=` where coercion can change meaning; `NaN` comparisons; `typeof null`.
Optional chaining that hides a missing required field instead of surfacing it.
`JSON.parse` on untrusted input without validation of the shape.

checks.title: Runtime boundaries
items: Prototype pollution via merging untrusted objects (`Object.assign`/spread into a prototype chain).
Array index arithmetic on user-controlled lengths.
